## Problem and requirement
Link issue, requirement/AC and risk. Explain concrete before/after behaviour.

## Verification
Record exact commands, results, CI run URL and commit SHA. Include negative cases and limitations.

## Review (two independent teammates required)
- [ ] Reviewer 1 checked implementation, test assertions and traceability; record findings and fixes.
- [ ] Reviewer 2 checked security, CI failure behaviour and evidence; record findings and fixes.
- [ ] No secrets; AI register and affected PED/RTM/register entries updated.
- [ ] Required checks passed on latest PR head; approvals remain valid.
